artworks.title: Deer Chased by a Dog to the Right
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a pursuit scene in a natural landscape. A deer leaps in the foreground while a hound runs to the right. In the distance, more hounds and potentially riders chase another deer. The intricate etching style features fine cross-hatching and detailed line work for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of sepia and light-dark contrast. The composition centers around a large tree amid the chase.

artworks.title: Deer Chased by Two Dogs to the Left
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stag being pursued by a dog. The drawing depicts a scene with a stag leaping across the landscape, followed closely by a dog. The background features trees and hills, with a sky filled with clouds. The drawing includes detailed linework for the setting and animals, with cross-hatching for texture and realism.

artworks.title: Stag at Bay
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene with a deer and dogs. The drawing depicts a chase between a deer and hunting dogs. A figure on horseback wields a long spear attempting to engage with the deer. Another figure on horseback is in the background. The scene is set on an open field with foliage and clouds in the distance, providing a sense of movement. The detailed lines and shading enhance the intensity of the scene.

artworks.title: Ostrich Hunt
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ostrich running. The scene depicts an ostrich in motion, dominating the center of the composition with its long legs and fluffy plumage. The background shows land with vegetation and a lightly clouded sky. A dog is also shown running and a distant figure, possibly on horseback, adds an adventurous element to the scene. The drawing showcases a sense of movement and energy, using intricate line work and shading for details.

artworks.title: Two Eagles with Tower in Background
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a detailed illustration of two eagles standing on rocky ground. The birds are depicted with fine line work, emphasizing their feathered texture. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape with sparse vegetation and a structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Two Eagles on a Promitory
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: Two birds of prey are depicted in the image. One bird is sitting and facing upward on the left, while the other is on the right busy with something on the ground. The color palette is mostly brown and black lines on a tan background, resembling an etching style. The larger bird in the foreground has its wings spread back on the left side, while the second bird on the right is bent over, with emphasis on its claws and head. Faint outlines of cliffs and hills are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, One Eating a Small Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two large birds. One bird stands on the left with its head down, engaged in feeding on something on the ground, while the other bird stands more upright on the right, looking off to the side. The scene is set against a sparse landscape with minimal background detail. The sky is subtly sketched. The drawing is created using fine lines and shading to depict the feathers and textures of the birds.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, Both with Heads Turned to the Left
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds of prey perched on a rocky landscape. The scene shows two large birds positioned among rocks and overlooking a vast terrain. The foreground bird stands on a rocky outcrop with its talons clutching the stone, while its gaze is fixed into the distance. To the left, a second bird occupies another rocky perch with its neck extended and head turned upwards. In the background, there is a rolling landscape with trees, rocky formations, and clouds in the sky. The line work in the drawing gives a sense of texture and movement.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, Both with Heads Turned to the Right
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This image shows two eagles perched in a mountainous landscape. The drawing features two large eagles standing on rocky terrain, with cliffs and a distant peak in the background. Both eagles are depicted in a highly detailed manner, showcasing their sharp beaks and powerful talons. The cross-hatching technique gives texture to their feathers and emphasizes light and shadow, lending a sense of depth and realism to the creatures. The setting is an open sky with a few clouds.

artworks.title: Two Eagles, Both with Heads Turned to the Left, On a High Cliff
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two large birds perched on a rocky landscape. The drawing depicts two birds with detailed feathers using fine lines. One bird is in the foreground on the right, gazing into the distance, while the second bird is placed slightly behind and to the left. The birds appear to be vultures or eagles, evident by their robust build and curved beaks. In the background, a rocky cliff can be seen to the right with minimal sketched lines indicating an expansive sky above. The overall composition captures a sense of wilderness and natural majesty in the backdrop of a rugged landscape.

artworks.title: Head of a Stag Turned Right
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a deer's profile. The image shows the head and upper neck of a deer with detailed antlers. The antlers have a natural curvature and spread of tines. The deer's eye has a highlight, and its mouth is slightly open. The fur texture is detailed to show depth and realism. The drawing has a monochromatic color scheme and precise line work.

artworks.title: Child Playing with a Dog
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two children with dogs in a rustic setting. One child is interacting with a small dog in the foreground, while the other child sits quietly in the background holding an object. The setting includes large stone structures and a sky with clouds. The illustration captures a scene of childlike interaction with detailed line work depicting texture.

artworks.title: Child Wearing a Mask
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a figure with a child-like body and an oversized adult head in a surreal style. The figure stands on a shaded ground with one arm bent upwards and the hand resting on the head, while the other arm is positioned in front of the face. The large head has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard, contrasting with the small body. The background has curved, horizontal lines for texture.

artworks.title: Academy of a Young Man
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a full-body figure from the back and slightly from the side. The person is leaning forward with arms resting on a surface. One foot is in front of the other, and the posture appears relaxed or thoughtful. The facial features are outlined, with eyes looking downwards, an elongated nose, closed lips, and short, wavy hair. The upper body is bare, showing muscle outlines. The lower body is draped with loosely drawn fabric, leaving the feet exposed. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background consists of diagonal and curved lines, adding texture and depth.

artworks.title: Four Turks Wearing Turbans
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of four men depicted in side profile, facing different directions. Each man has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, mustache, and short beard. They wear turbans or hats with variations in style. The men are dressed in robes or tunics with visible folds, drawn in a detailed sketch style. The background is plain, emphasizing the men's features and clothing details.

artworks.title: Four Turks and a Black Man
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile view of four men's upper bodies. They are positioned in a line, with three facing leftwards and one facing right. The first man on the left has short curly hair, the next two have large turbans, and the fourth wears his hair wrapped or tied back. The men are wearing robes or tunics. No jewelry is visible, and they are not holding any objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Polish Attendant Holding the Bridle of a Horse
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows two sections featuring interactions between people and horses. In the right section, a person is depicted from behind, wearing a turban and a long coat, holding the head of a horse facing them. The horse's head is adorned with a decorative ribbon and bridle. In the left section, another person is shown sitting upright on a horse, facing to the left. Both individuals are dressed in coats and turbans, with the horse standing still beneath them. The drawing is done in an etching style with cross-hatching and fine lines, focusing on the figures and horses without a detailed background.

artworks.title: Pole Holding the Bridle of a Horse while Speaking with Two Other Men
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of the bodies of four individuals and a horse. The individuals are positioned mostly in profile or slightly turned away from the viewer. The closest person to the horse has discernible facial features, sporting a prominent nose and wearing a hat with feathers protruding from it. The person interacting with the horse appears to have a rounded belly. Another individual, positioned slightly further back, is seen from the back, wearing a cape and a hat with a feather. The fourth individual is partially obscured, with only their head and shoulders visible, featuring a cap and what appears to be facial hair. Clothing consists of cloaks and coats, typical of a historical style, and a sword is noticeable on one person's side. The background is plain, allowing focus on the sketched figures, and the horse is prominently featured, with a bridle visibly wrapped around its head.

artworks.title: A Black Man Feeding a Horse
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing next to a horse. The individual looks towards the same direction as the horse. The person has short curly hair and wears a loose garment, possibly a robe. The horse has ornate decorative elements on its bridle. In the background, there is another figure on horseback wearing a hat with a feather and a thick coat or cloak. The background is a simple line-drawn texture.

artworks.title: Suicide of Dido
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a dynamic posture. One arm is outstretched, while the other holds a long sword pointing towards the ground. The individual has distinct facial features, including prominent cheekbones and curly hair. They are dressed in a flowing garment, resembling a robe or toga, and are not wearing any visible jewelry. The background is plain, focusing attention on the figure's stance, attire, and sword.

artworks.title: Polish Attendant with Two Horses
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on a horse. He is turned slightly to his right side, showing a profile and partial rear view. The man has a mustache, wears a hat that appears to wrap turban-style, and is dressed in a long robe or coat with a belt. Another horse is seen in the background, tethered and trailing behind the first horse. The background shows faint outlines suggesting a landscape of rolling hills or dunes in the distance.

artworks.title: An Old Turk with Turban Seated on a Rock
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is a three-quarter view of an individual seated or crouched down. The person is facing slightly to the left, with their body leaning forward and arms resting on their knees. The face is shown in profile with a well-defined, prominent nose and a thick mustache. The person has short facial hair on their chin. They are wearing a large turban wrapped around their head, along with a cloak draped over their shoulders and a loose-fitting garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of sketch-like outlines that suggest architectural elements. The overall illustration style is etched, with cross-hatching used for shading and texture.

artworks.title: Soldier Holding a Fowl by the Feet
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an open landscape. On the left is a man walking with a rifle and a rabbit in his hand. He wears a hat with a feather and his face is not visible. In the background, a person rides a horse with a similar outfit. To the right is a child raising arms facing the rider. The setting is an open field.

artworks.title: Pole Holding a Hatchet with His Left Hand
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures from behind. The larger figure stands with a relaxed posture, holding an object in his left hand. This figure has a beard and is wearing a headpiece with a long feather or ribbon extending from the back. Their clothing is a long, flowing garment reaching down to the ankles with voluminous sleeves and a cape draping from the shoulders. A sword or scabbard is visible on the left side, hanging from a belt. The smaller figure stands a short distance away, looking up at the larger person, dressed in a similarly styled tunic with striped sleeves and headwear. The background is a plain, lightly shaded space with minimal detail, including a small drawing of two distant figures on horseback.
